old_description:
Description

Discover the Ohuhu Honolulu Markers 48 Pastel Colors Sanrio Collab Professional Set, a delightful collection designed to inspire creativity and bring your artistic ideas to life. This exclusive set combines the trusted quality of Ohuhu markers with the charming appeal of Sanrio characters, offering a unique and enjoyable drawing experience. With a palette of 48 soft pastel hues, these markers are perfect for adding gentle, vibrant touches to your illustrations, sketches, and coloring projects.

Each marker in this professional-grade set features a dual-tip design, including a fine tip for detailed work and a chisel tip for broader strokes, giving you versatility in your artwork. The smooth and blendable ink allows for seamless gradients and stunning effects, making it suitable for artists of all skill levels. Whether you are a beginner or a seasoned professional, this set enhances your creative projects while adding a touch of kawaii charm.

Details

• Product Material: Ink and plastic

• Manufacturer: Ohuhu

Features

  • Contains 48 pastel color markers for varied artistic expression
  • Dual-tip design with fine and chisel tips for detailed and broad strokes
  • Smooth and blendable ink ideal for seamless color gradients
  • Collaboration with Sanrio featuring charming character designs
  • Suitable for artists of all levels, from beginners to professionals

How to use

Select the desired marker tip based on your drawing needs—use the fine tip for detailed lines and the chisel tip for filling larger areas or creating broad strokes. Begin your artwork on suitable paper designed for markers to prevent bleeding. Blend colors by layering and overlapping strokes while the ink is still wet for smooth transitions. Always recap markers after use to prevent drying and store them horizontally to maintain ink flow.

Care instructions

Keep markers capped tightly when not in use to prevent ink from drying out. Store the set in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and extreme temperatures to maintain quality. Clean marker tips gently with a damp cloth if ink buildup occurs. Avoid using harsh chemicals or solvents on markers to preserve their performance and appearance.
